svg.title: A p-value is an area under the no-effect curve
svg.desc: Hypothetical yield example. Two normal sampling distributions have standard error 0.20 Mg/ha. The solid blue curve assumes a true difference of zero. The dashed orange curve assumes a true difference of positive 0.40 Mg/ha. The observed estimate is positive 0.40. The hatched right tail under the solid curve has area approximately 0.023, the one-sided p-value.

g.text: Curves describe estimates from repeated studies.
Estimated yield difference (treatment minus control), Mg/ha
Illustrative normal model; standard error = 0.20 Mg/ha; one-sided test.
